assessment: The authors performed an important study to demonstrate efficacy of lonafarnib, the only approved drug for treating progeria in patients, using a well-established mouse model of the disease. The authors provided convincing evidence that lonafarnib extends lifespan in these mice that is associated with reduced arterial thickening and improved arterial function in an experimental model progeria. This paper is of major interest to scientists and clinicians interested in cardiovascular physiopathology, aging, and progeria in particular.
